Both PRs change close() to proactively settle those pending responses instead of leaving them open. (2 PRs)

clusters.pick_reason: #2763 ships a changeset (this monorepo requires one for release) and its description states the fix covers both the no-progress case (caps the initial _setupTimeout arm at min(timeout, maxTotalTimeout)) and the progress-notification case ('progress resets re-arm against the remaining budget'), i.e. it already addresses the same code path #2817 touches. #2817 has no changeset, only edits an existing test's comment rather than adding a new regression test, and its fix (unconditionally setting info.startTime = Date.now() on every progress reset) resets the maxTotalTimeout clock on each progress notification instead of enforcing it as a hard ceiling from request start — the opposite of the 'hard cap even with progress' behavior #2763 implements.

members.cluster_pick_reason: #2692's close() settles outstanding request ids with a JSON-RPC error object (-32000 'Connection closed'), consistent with the JSON-RPC-shaped error responses used elsewhere in this file (e.g. the -32000 errors in #2669's DELETE handling), whereas #2600 settles them with a bare HTTP 404 'Session not found', which is semantically about a missing session rather than an in-flight request being cut off. #2692 also explicitly groups outstanding request ids by stream to handle batched POSTs (multiple request ids sharing one stream mapping) and reuses an already-computed real response instead of overwriting it with an error, handling an edge case not mentioned in #2600's diff/changeset. #2600 additionally bundles in an unrelated fix (clearing _requestToStreamMapping to stop a separate correlation leak in send()/storeEvent()), which is a legitimate but distinct bug that should be tracked/landed separately from the request-hang fix rather than folded into the same change.

clusters.pick_reason: #2763 ships a changeset (this monorepo requires one for release) and its description states the fix covers both the no-progress case (caps the initial _setupTimeout arm at min(timeout, maxTotalTimeout)) and the progress-notification case ('progress resets re-arm against the remaining budget'), i.e. it already addresses the same code path #2817 touches. #2817 has no changeset, only edits an existing test's comment rather than adding a new regression test, and its fix (unconditionally setting info.startTime = Date.now() on every progress reset) resets the maxTotalTimeout clock on each progress notification instead of enforcing it as a hard ceiling from request start — the opposite of the 'hard cap even with progress' behavior #2763 implements.
